In this masterclass you study Chandella temple architecture and sculptural context.

Length, level and language are agreed with you. It can be given online or at your venue, as a single session or as part of a series.

What it covers

  • Chandella background
  • Plan & elevations
  • Sculptural programme

How the time is spent

  1. Chandella background 30 min

    Chronology and temple groups.

    You: timeline

  2. Plan & elevations 60 min

    Kandariya Mahadeva plan and clustered towers.

    You: label plan

  3. Sculptural programme 30 min

    Read images within larger programme.

    You: interpretation note

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Place the Chandella temples of Khajuraho in their chronology and temple groups.
  • Read the plan and clustered towers of the Kandariya Mahadeva temple.
  • Interpret individual sculptures within the larger sculptural programme of a temple.
